AMREX INPUTS PARSER DEFECT FOUND WHILE BUILDING THIS COVERAGE: a comment line whose first token after '#' is `else` or `endif` SEGFAULTS the AMReX inputs parser. Deterministic 5/5, minimal reproducer is a three-line inputs file whose first line is '#else' with no FILE include. AMReX_ParmParse.cpp:275 treats '#' as a plain comment start, so there is no documented conditional-directive feature being misused -- the parser dies instead of diagnosing. It bit this campaign because the variant inputs quote Fortran if/else/endif blocks inside '#' comment blocks. Workaround in force: keep a non-alphabetic gutter (e.g. '#   |') between '#' and any pasted preprocessor keyword. Not a WDM6 defect and not an ERF defect; worth filing upstream.
